rows.note: Use 外人 as the all-purpose term for someone outside a group or community.

example.english: This is a members-only gathering, so an outsider should not join.
example.traditional: 呢個係會員聚會，外人唔好參加。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 wui6 jyun4 zeoi6 wui6 ngoi6 jan4 m4 hou2 caam1 gaa1

rows.note: Use 新丁 for a new and inexperienced member of a group, rather than someone who is simply not a member.

example.english: When I first joined the industry, people always treated me as an outsider.
example.traditional: 我初初入行嗰陣，成日畀人當新丁睇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 co1 co1 jap6 hong4 go2 zan6 seng4 jat6 bei2 jan4 dong3 san1 ding1 tai2

rows.note: Use 陪跑份子 for a contestant in a competition or election who is expected to lose.

example.english: In this election, they are clearly an outsider with little chance of winning.
example.traditional: 今次選舉佢擺明係陪跑份子，冇乜機會贏。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 syun2 geoi2 keoi5 baai2 ming4 hai6 pui4 paau2 fan6 zi2 mou5 mat1 gei1 wui6 jeng4
